ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-dominance of low-intensity black pixels (>90%) with sparse high-intensity white linear disruptions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black mapping across central and upper regions. Focal high-contrast white linear groupings located in the lower-left and lower-right quadrants. High-intensity cluster on the far distal left tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped depression with a wide obtuse angle and low bounding-box depth relative to fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular topography. Features a major high-amplitude rectangular indentation on the upper-left lobe boundary. Continuous low-amplitude serrations mapped across the right lobe boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature extending from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small circular high-contrast white pixel clusters detected on the far left tip and along the right lobe trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive parallel sets of white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on both lobes, trending diagonally from the lower center toward the outer edges.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major V-shaped/rectangular tissue loss on the upper trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, multi-striated parallel rake mark patterns covering approximately 30% of the visible ventral surface.
